svg.title: Compact student architecture
svg.desc: The deployed student uses a shared MC3-18 visual encoder and separate skeleton/IMU encoders. Clip-level visual queries attend to aligned motion tokens before view/window aggregation; a second motion residual is added to the global trial embedding. Dimensions omit batch size. Auxiliary training heads and optional disabled branches are omitted; the diagram depicts the final prediction path.
svg.text: Local residual before view/window aggregation; global residual after aggregation.
